status: Performed bounded local verification on committed runtime; final publication audited separately before goal completion

criteria.expected: Independent repository handles and OS processes preserve unique identities, stale object/schema/project/endpoint guards, atomic rollback, ordered immutable history and usable recovery across concurrent native/schema/link/resource operations. Every acknowledged update survives; contention may reject explicitly without silent replay.
criteria.performed: Six native process scenarios cover version/schema/identity/endpoints and cascading relink order; portable rollback/history contracts and process held-lock checks pass.

criteria.expected: Identical and conflicting command IDs under genuine process overlap produce at most one durable success per family/identity with exact original intent/outcome inspection after reopen; native plus receipt changes never publish partially.
criteria.performed: Held uncommitted native-plus-receipt commands reject identical and differing concurrent intents busy, then retain exact original success, reject conflicting committed intent and repeat known success without writes. Native/evaluation and HTTP identity races preserve one outcome.

criteria.expected: Declared read-only operations observe one committed native/evidence snapshot without reserving the writer slot. Readers coexist with readers and an active writer under WAL; writes through a read-only transaction reject atomically. Separate requests retain their existing pagination guarantees, without an invented shared snapshot; guarded continuations reject changes as already promised.
criteria.performed: Independent reader snapshot remains at revision1 while another process commits revision2; readers run under held writer; attempted read-only writes reject and next write succeeds. New evidence rejects old HTTP continuation; separate requests do not share snapshots.

criteria.expected: Genuinely concurrent assessment and verification work preserves pinned models, selected configuration comparison and candidate applicability. Unrelated head changes never silently change fixed pair meaning; conflicting basis, actions or conclusions reject or require deliberate reassessment.
criteria.performed: Independent engineering/research activity-capture, result-selection, disposition/action and changed-basis tasks retain one guarded result and reject stale inputs/unsupported completion. Actual-project and research reopen races retain original evidence and exact configuration pair meaning.

criteria.expected: Process termination before commit leaves no partial native/evidence/outcome writes; termination after commit and response loss recovers exact original success by inspection after restart. No automatic uncertain-write replay.
criteria.performed: Worker termination before commit restores complete prior export; after commit retains native/receipt/outcome for inspection. Two server processes, restarted server and CLI inspect a deliberately dropped committed response after exactly one POST.

criteria.expected: SQLite-aware online backup during active work restores a complete committed state with native/evidence history and outcome identities intact; current engineering application capabilities remain usable after restore.
criteria.performed: SQLite online backup during held actual-project writes restores exact preceding committed export and controlled application reads. Original and complete restored outcome ledgers are separately compared before final publication.

criteria.expected: Reproducible real-project and connected synthetic workloads report exact candidate, environment, counts, latency distributions, RSS/heap, payload/work bounds and contention. Explicit engineering budgets are fixed after initial baseline and before optimization; overflow is explained, never silently truncated.
criteria.performed: Pre-change synthetic baseline; explicitly disclosed post-correctness-fix real baseline, fixed budgets before subsequent workload work and no query optimization. Actual and connected-synthetic 2/4 readers plus writer meet budgets; all56 dependency pages streamed, response cap rejected explicitly, query calls/payload/rows measured with stated limitations.

criteria.expected: Core, typed HTTP/client, CLI and relevant existing shared-workspace task checks cover success, rejection and uncertain recovery under declared workloads. Portable contracts distinguish adapter obligations from SQLite implementation proof; future authentication/backend parity stays unproven.
criteria.performed: New independent HTTP/client and CLI proof plus unchanged full shared workspace, interface and recovery regressions. Different schema bindings retain same meaning. Full browser/workbench run passes on final source.

criteria.expected: Appropriate unchanged regression, browser, architecture and quality checks pass. Owning docs, checkpoint, guarded register, deterministic export and restored online backup retain exact evidence, limits and independent delivery/verification/human-validation status. Audit all criteria and the complete goal before completion.
criteria.performed: All final-source checks underlying npm run check pass unchanged, including720 unit/219 browser/18 original workbench screenshots and dependency/dead-code/duplication/complexity gates. Prepublication live/export/online-restored backup/ledger proof passes. Final native promotion and its preservation are separately audited before goal completion.

gates.finalFollowOnCommand: npm run test:ui && npm run workbench:check && npm run quality
gates.qualityWorkerRefactor: Initial combined run passed all behavioral checks but failed the new monolithic worker complexity. Split worker;720 units and complete219 browser/workbench/quality rerun pass. Production source unchanged by the worker-only refactor.

limits: Local trusted-process SQLite proof only; REQ-025 future authentication/backend obligation unchanged.
Declared actual and connected synthetic populations, one run per adversarial scenario and sampled RSS; not arbitrary scale, continuous memory peak or hardware-independent SLA.
Synthetic domain attestations are lifecycle-contract proof, not representative-human/scientific/physical validation.
Existing cap rejects page25; all56 page1 receipts still exhausted. Query counts are driver-call/returned-row observations, not scan complexity bounds.
Already-open read transactions avoid writer reservation; startup migration/index checks can still contend and return busy. No migrations or additional adapters introduced.
finalPublication: A separate final audit must confirm guarded status publication, complete backup, restored command ledgers/export and exact code fingerprints before goal completion.
